read.thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone net revenue +3% and EBITDA -17% on cigarette tax shock (Cigarette segment PBIT -27%), while non-cigarette segments grew 18% revenue and 23% EBITDA; paper pricing recovering with segment PBIT margin up 320 bps LTL.
